Story (story.md): Story paragraph: for each person there is the outcome they would have had if treated and if not; I only see one; randomization makes assignment independent of both.
Technical (chapter.md): Loop C: each unit has Y(0) and Y(1); we see one or the other. The book has used this implicitly since Ch 8; now it is named. ATE = E[Y(1)-Y(0)]; selection bias = E[Y(0)|treated] - E[Y(0)|untreated]; identification as the joint question of data + assumptions.
